verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents a managed Kubernetes service (CKS) on bare metal, with clusters created via Console, Terraform, or API, kubectl access, and Cluster Autoscaler-driven Node Pools. It also offers SUNK, which runs managed Slurm on Kubernetes so batch training jobs and Kubernetes services share one GPU pool. Together these remove the need to build a custom scheduler on raw nodes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of running jobs on CKS/SUNK, and deeper SUNK documentation on job submission and scheduling behavior beyond the overview page.
